title: simplifaisoul/osiris
claim: simplifaisoul/osiris — Open Source Global Intelligence Platform - Real-Time OSINT Dashboard - A Palantir Alternative -            We Get 0.5% o
why_good: An open-source real-time OSINT dashboard pitched as a Palantir alternative — a huge, high-budget market where an open, cheaper option has real pull.
value: Sell hosted + support + compliance to security teams, journalists and mid-size gov/enterprise priced out of Palantir.
risk: OSINT/intel is regulation- and trust-heavy; Palantir's moat is integrations and gov relationships, not the dashboard.
pick_reason: The project offers a specialized OSINT dashboard that can be monetized for niche markets.
